finding.claim_mismatch: NS011 receipt describes a local authoritative callback over retained canonical bytes, but the supplied callback never checks any bytes. reuse_analysis declares paper_claim.blocked=false and qualified_with_finite_uncertainty. Those labels do not establish an admitted proof-backed production reuse path.

criteria_assessment.criterion1: Actual separate cold recording and skip/unavailable rejection supported for the controlled harness.
criteria_assessment.criterion2: Identity invalidation and unchanged cold-positive cases supported conditionally; genuine admitted-result authority not established because verifier and certificates are synthetic.
criteria_assessment.criterion3: 26-case all-attempted empirical count and observed stale-key failure retained, but statistical intervals apply only to this controlled mocked-verifier cohort.
criteria_assessment.criterion4: Stale-key profile is explicitly excluded; mocked certificate/verifier admission is not marked blocked in the paper-claim profile. This qualification cannot authorize production/final reuse.
